content.fact_text: Implementation of a production-ready Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) handler for the fraud detection engine, ensuring reliable event routing for failed processing attempts.

provenance_data.behaviour: Initializes a singleton-based Kafka DLQ handler that routes failed events with full metadata, error context, and original signature to a configured Kafka topic using GZIP compression. Features non-blocking asynchronous dispatch, Prometheus instrumentation for ingress metrics and latency, and robust producer lifecycle management.
